statement: Across kernel-only and Steam physical sessions, feature GET requests asked for 64 bytes but all observed GET completions delivered 63 bytes including report ID 1. Attributes have declared inner length 30 and six 5-byte entries. Serial replies declare inner length 20 with 13-character NUL-terminated strings; actual characters are withheld. Selector 1 has class pattern UUUDDDDDDDUUD and selector 0 UUUDUDDDDDDDD (U uppercase ASCII, D digit). Accepted serial request prefixes: 01 ae 16 01, 01 ae 15 01, 01 ae 15 00, 01 ae 01 01; opaque request tails withheld. The three ED replies declare inner lengths 1, 24, 0 after SETs declaring 24, 9, 11. Only the first meaningful one-byte value (00) is reviewed as non-identifying; its prefix is 01 ed 01 00, with opaque tails and other ED bodies withheld. SET requests delivered 64 bytes. Steam session C1 SETs returned -32 (STALL) 100 times. DC SET body 01 02 and E2 SET body 01 20 (both declared length 2, twice each) completed status 0; ED SET/GET also completed status 0. These are observed outcomes, not authorization to inject commands or an explanation of semantics; no retention is established.
